definitions.explanation: A feeling of being annoyed or frustrated.

examples.japanese: {苛立|いらだ}ちを{隠|かく}せない。
{苛立|いらだ}ちを{感|かん}じる。

notes:
{苛立|いらだ}ち is the noun form of {苛立|いらだ}つ, expressing irritation or frustration.

RELATED FORMS:
- {苛立|いらだ}つ (verb): to be irritated
- {苛立|いらだ}たしい (adjective): irritating, frustrating
- {苛立|いらだ}ち (noun): irritation

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {苛立|いらだ}ちを{覚|おぼ}える: to feel irritation
- {苛立|いらだ}ちを{感|かん}じる: to feel frustration
- {苛立|いらだ}ちが{募|つの}る: frustration builds up
- {苛立|いらだ}ちを{隠|かく}す: to hide one's irritation
- {苛立|いらだ}ちを{抑|おさ}える: to suppress irritation

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- イライラ: irritation (onomatopoeia, more casual)
- {焦|いら}り: frustration, impatience
- もどかしさ: frustration (at inability to do something)
